column4: Goal: Make issuer, wallet, and verifier interoperable with standard OID4VC and EUDI-aligned profiles. Scope includes protocol compliance, interoperability testing, security hardening, and readiness for certification.

column3: Support standard OID4VCI credential_offer QR parsing
column4:
As a wallet integrator, I want to parse standard OID4VCI credential_offer QR payloads so that I can onboard credentials from third-party issuers.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Supports openid-credential-offer:// scheme
- Supports both credential_offer and credential_offer_uri
- Returns standard protocol errors (invalid_request, invalid_grant)

column3: Handle one-time pre-authorized_code without false success
column4:
As a wallet user, I want clear handling for one-time pre-authorized_code so that I never see false 'Stored 0 credentials' success states.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Explicit error when code is consumed or expired
- No success UI state when credentialCount is 0
- Technical root cause is logged

column3: Build proof JWTs per OID4VCI spec
column4:
As a wallet, I want proof JWTs built per spec (iss, aud, nonce, negotiated alg) so that interoperable issuers accept credential requests.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Validates c_nonce usage
- Supports at least ES256
- Shows user-friendly proof-related errors

As an issuer, I want complete OID4VCI metadata published so that external wallets can auto-configure without custom integration.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Valid /.well-known/openid-credential-issuer endpoint
- Required metadata fields are present
- Metadata schema validation runs in CI

As an issuer, I want to issue credentials in EUDI-target interoperable formats (beyond JWT VC) so that multiple wallet types are supported.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Supports selected target format(s): SD-JWT VC and/or mdoc
- End-to-end issuance tests pass
- Backward compatibility is preserved

column3: Implement OID4VP 1.0 final compliant verifier flow
column4:
As a verifier, I want OID4VP 1.0 final compliant request/response handling so that external wallets can present credentials without custom adapters.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Request object is compliant
- Nonce and state handling is robust
- vp_token and presentation_submission are fully verified

column3: Implement key lifecycle controls for compliance
column4:
As a security officer, I want compliant key lifecycle management (rotation, kid, JWKS, audit trail) so that operational and cryptographic risk is controlled.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Documented key rotation policy
- JWKS endpoint is available and correct
- Signing and verification events are auditable

column3: Keep did:key interoperability without blockchain dependency
column4:
As a solution architect, I want to keep did:key (no blockchain dependency) while staying standards-compliant so that infrastructure remains simple and interoperable.

Acceptance Criteria:
- DID method is configurable
- Trust model is documented without DLT dependency
- Interoperability tests with external issuers and wallets pass

column3: Automate OIDF conformance tests in CI
column4:
As QA, I want OIDF conformance tests automated in CI so that protocol regressions are blocked before release.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Conformance pipeline runs automatically
- Versioned pass/fail reports are produced
- Release gate blocks on critical failures

column3: Produce EUDI/eIDAS readiness checklist and roadmap
column4:
As a product owner, I want an EUDI/eIDAS readiness checklist so that certification scope, timeline, and cost are predictable.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Technical and legal gap analysis is delivered
- P0/P1/P2 priorities are defined
- Milestone-based roadmap is approved
